tytul: Czech pickled camembert in oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Czech pickled camembert (nakládaný hermelín), a soft white-mold cheese kept in oil with onion and peppers.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Low-acid foods stored in oil create an oxygen-free environment that is perfect for the growth of Clostridium botulinum bacteria.
In Canada, the CFIA recalled a labneh in vegetable oil because it may permit the growth of Clostridium botulinum.
Food contaminated with Clostridium botulinum toxin may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick.
Listeria can thrive in cold environments, including inside refrigerators.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for pickled camembert in oil from a checked source.
